# AGENTS.md

# AGENTS.md — Blue Roster Design System rules

This file is the single source of rules for every AI coding agent (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, others) building Blue Roster UI. `CLAUDE.md` and `.cursor/rules/blueroster.mdc` point here. `.cursor/rules/blueroster-build.mdc` repeats the Playbook. Read this file, then `tokens/` (including `tokens/events.md` and `tokens/typography.md`), `patterns/`, `components/` and the relevant `screens/` spec (with its PNGs in `img/` and node tree in `json/`) before writing UI code. Requests that say **Blue Roster**, **Blue Roster Legacy**, or **BR** follow the Playbook at the end of this file.

Figma source: **Design System Legacy** — https://www.figma.com/design/k05NWBKMjsvo5hEugQc2Tq/Design-System-Legacy (fileKey `k05NWBKMjsvo5hEugQc2Tq`).

## 1. Reuse, never redraw
- Build every screen from existing components. Look up `components/` first; if a `br-*`, `br-m-*` or `ms-*` component covers the need, use it.
- **Storybook is the source of truth for code.** The Angular `br-*` components in Storybook are what you import. Figma names match Storybook names (`br-button`, `br-input`, `br-table`, ...).
- Never re-implement a component with raw HTML/CSS. If something is genuinely missing, say so in the PR and propose a new component instead of inlining a one-off.

## 2. Tokens, not hex
- Every color, spacing, radius and typography value comes from `tokens/tokens.css` (CSS variables) or `tokens/tokens.json`.
- Prefer semantic `br/*` tokens (`--br-...`, including `br/event-*` for schedule events) over raw `mat/*` palette tokens.
- No hard-coded hex, rgb or px values where a token exists.

## 3. Light and Dark
- Every screen and component must work in both themes. Themes switch with `[data-theme="dark"]` on a root element; Light is the default (`:root`).
- Verify both themes before finishing.

## 4. Icons
- Use **Material Icons Outlined** only. Do not mix icon sets.

## 5. Platforms and layout
- **Employee app is mobile first** (390 wide reference; tablet 768 reference exists for Overtime). Desktop (1440) uses `br-app-shell` with `App=Employee`.
- **Admin app** is desktop web (1440×900) with `br-app-shell` `App=Admin`.
- App shell variants: `br-app-shell` → `App=Admin | Employee`. Employee sidebar: My Schedule, Overtime, Time Off, Sick Time, Logout. Mobile uses `br-m-app-bar` + `br-m-nav-drawer`.
- Page content components are named `br-content-<section>-<tab>` (e.g. `br-content-rosters-assignment`, `br-content-roster-catalogs-shift`). Follow that naming for new screens.
- Page header + tabs: `br-page-header` with `br-page-tab`.

## 6. Filter pattern
- **1–3 filters:** inline. On desktop they sit in **one row**.
- **4+ filters:** collapse them into a single dialog (`br-filter-dialog`, `Device=Mobile|Desktop`) opened by `br-filter-button` (shows a badge with the active filter count). One dialog for all filters, not one dialog per filter.
- Mobile dialog: full screen with Clear all / Apply pinned at the bottom. Desktop dialog: centered, 560 wide.

## 7. Calendars and dates
- Use **Mobiscroll** (`br-mobiscroll` and `br-mobiscroll-*`) for calendars, timelines, agenda and schedulers. Date inputs use `br-single-datepicker`, `br-range-datepicker`, `br-inline-datepicker` and the `br-linear-*-selector` components.

## 8. Tables, empty states, services
- Tables: `br-table` (+ `br-table-row`, `br-table-cell`, `br-table-header-cell`, `br-paginator`). Responsive data: `br-responsive-table`.
- Empty states: `br-empty-state-panel` (desktop) / `br-m-empty-state` (mobile).
- Dialogs, drawers, toasts and confirmations go through the services on the Figma *Services* page (dialog, drawer, confirmationDialogService, result dialog, toast). Do not hand-build modals.

## 9. Data honesty
- Text and numbers in Figma frames are illustrative. Do not copy them as real data, API fields or business rules.
- **Mockups may use sample data from `fixtures/`** (copied verbatim from the Figma frames and labelled sample). Use it for visual prototypes and mockups only; label it as sample data and never treat it as an API contract. Do not invent other data; if `fixtures/` has nothing that fits, reuse the closest sample and say so.
- Specs in `screens/` must not contain invented data or behavior. If a requirement is unknown, write "TBD" and ask.

## 9b. Match the Figma reference
- Each spec embeds Light and Dark PNGs exported from Figma (`screens/<group>/img/`). Compare your result against them before finishing.
- Event colors come from `tokens/events.md` (Shift = neutral gray `--br-event-shift-neutral`, Tasks = solid `--br-event-shift` with white text, Overtime `--br-event-overtime`, Planned overtime `--br-special-4`, Leave `--br-event-leave`).
- Type is **Roboto** (see `tokens/typography.md`); icons are Material Icons Outlined.
- Time/date formats and copy: `patterns/formats.md` (12-hour `6 AM` labels, `Thu 8 Oct 2026`). Calendar geometry: `patterns/calendar-layout.md` (48px per hour, overlapping events side by side).
- Logo and avatar/badge specs: `assets/`. Never redraw the logo.
- For non-Angular mockups (Claude, Figma Make, plain HTML) start from `starter/` (`br-m.css`, `components.html`, `my-schedule-day.html`).

## 10. Known gaps (do not silently invent)
Loading / error / skeleton states, formal breakpoints, avatar initials variant (see `assets/README.md` for how the app bar draws it), `br-textarea` variant in `br-input`, no `br/event-planned-overtime` alias (the design uses `br/special-4`, see `tokens/events.md`), accent palette update, sticky behaviour of page header/tabs on My Schedule, multi-employee mobile calendar, unpublished Figma library. See README. When you hit one, flag it in your PR.

## Definition of done for UI work
- Uses existing components and tokens only (or flags the gap).
- Works in Light and Dark.
- Employee screens verified at 390 first, then desktop.
- Filter count follows the 1–3 / 4+ rule.
- Links the Figma node it implements in the PR description.

## Playbook

Follow this playbook when the request says **Blue Roster**, **Blue Roster Legacy**, or **BR**.

1. Read `AGENTS.md` and `tokens/` before writing UI (`tokens.css`, `tokens.json`, and the markdown tables).
2. Map the request to the closest spec in `screens/` and state which file you are following. Use the keyword table. If several rows match, pick one view and say why.
3. Build mobile first: **390**, then **768**, then **desktop**. Admin specs are drawn at 1440×900. If the chosen spec has no 390 or 768 frame, flag that gap instead of inventing a layout.
4. Colors use only `br/*` tokens, through the CSS variables in `tokens/tokens.css` (`--br-...`, slash becomes hyphen). Spacing, radius, and type use the variables in that same file (`--spacing`, `--radius-*`, `--text-*`, `--font-weight-*`). No hard-coded hex, rgb, or px where a token exists.
5. Use only components documented in `components/`. Calendars, timelines, agenda, and schedulers use Mobiscroll (`br-mobiscroll` and `br-mobiscroll-*`).
6. Filters: **1–3** stay inline (one row on desktop). **4+** go in one `br-filter-dialog`, opened by `br-filter-button`.
7. Deliver **Light and Dark**. Light is `:root`; Dark is `[data-theme="dark"]`.
8. Flag gaps instead of inventing components, tokens, states, copy, or behavior. Unknown items stay `TBD`.
9. Build **one view first** and ask for review before the next view.

### Keyword → spec

Keywords are request language. Each spec path is a file in `screens/`.

| Keywords | Spec |
|---|---|
| screen index, list of screens, qué pantallas | `screens/README.md` |
| action center, action center live, centro de acción | `screens/admin/action-center.md` |
| action center requests, requests tab | `screens/admin/action-center-requests.md` |
| catalogs user, user catalog, usuarios | `screens/admin/catalogs-user.md` |
| gantt production, production schedule, producción | `screens/admin/gantt-production-schedule.md` |
| gantt, projection, gantt projection | `screens/admin/gantt.md` |
| history, assignment history, historial de asignaciones | `screens/admin/history-assignments.md` |
| roles, roles management | `screens/admin/roles.md` |
| base model, modelo base, roster catalogs base model | `screens/admin/roster-catalogs-base-model.md` |
| model catalog, roster catalogs model | `screens/admin/roster-catalogs-model.md` |
| pattern catalog, patrón, roster catalogs pattern | `screens/admin/roster-catalogs-pattern.md` |
| shift catalog, turno, roster catalogs shift | `screens/admin/roster-catalogs-shift.md` |
| rosters list, rosters tab | `screens/admin/rosters-rosters.md` |
| rosters assignment, assignment planning | `screens/admin/rosters.md` |
| sign in, login, iniciar sesión | `screens/admin/sign-in.md` |
| workload engine | `screens/admin/workload-engine.md` |
| workload template, plantilla | `screens/admin/workload-template.md` |
| employee profile, perfil, profile desktop | `screens/employee-desktop/employee-profile-desktop.md` |
| my schedule desktop, agenda desktop, schedule desktop | `screens/employee-desktop/my-schedule-desktop-proposal.md` |
| overtime desktop, overtime filters desktop | `screens/employee-desktop/overtime-opportunities-desktop-filters.md` |
| avatar, language, notifications, nav drawer, idioma, notificaciones, menú | `screens/employee-mobile/global-overlays-avatar-menu-language-notifications-nav-drawer.md` |
| multi-employee calendar, team calendar on mobile, team schedule mobile, ver empleados en móvil, calendario de empleados móvil, calendario del equipo | **No spec yet. Stop and ask the user.** Offer `screens/admin/gantt.md` / `screens/admin/gantt-production-schedule.md` (desktop admin Gantt) as reference and the My Schedule mobile specs for styling; do not invent the layout. |
| agenda, schedule, my schedule, day, día, calendario | `screens/employee-mobile/my-schedule-day.md` |
| my schedule month, month, mes | `screens/employee-mobile/my-schedule-month.md` |
| my schedule week, week, semana | `screens/employee-mobile/my-schedule-week.md` |
| overtime approvals | `screens/employee-mobile/overtime-approvals.md` |
| overtime, overtime opportunities, horas extra | `screens/employee-mobile/overtime-opportunities.md` |
| sick time history, sick history | `screens/employee-mobile/sick-time-history.md` |
| sick time, sick request | `screens/employee-mobile/sick-time-request.md` |
| time off approvals | `screens/employee-mobile/time-off-approvals.md` |
| time off, time off request | `screens/employee-mobile/time-off-request.md` |

Disambiguation: "agenda" or "my schedule" with no Day, Week, or Month, and no desktop, maps to `screens/employee-mobile/my-schedule-day.md`. "Overtime" with no Approvals maps to Opportunities. Desktop or Admin in the request wins over the mobile row. State the chosen spec before building.

"My schedule" means the signed-in employee's own calendar. A request to see **several employees** (team, crew, roster, empleados) on mobile has **no spec**: say so, ask, and offer the Gantt desktop spec as reference.

# tokens/events.md

# Event tokens (schedule events)

Extracted from Figma (`br-m-event-block` 371:5384, `br-m-legend` 371:5362, `br-m-week-day` 371:5403, `br-m-month-cell` 371:5428) and from the My Schedule frames (372:5392 / 372:6394). Values are the variables **actually bound on screen**, resolved in the `s2d` collection for Light and Dark.

> Important: on screen, **Shift is neutral gray** and **Tasks is solid blue with white text**. The Task block is bound to `br/event-shift` (which aliases `br/primary`), not to `br/event-task`. Use the table below, not the token names, to decide colors.

## Event blocks (`br-m-event-block`, Type=…)

No border on any type. Radius 4px (no radius token for 4; use `calc(var(--spacing) * 1)`). Padding 6 top/bottom, 8 left/right, gap 2 between title and time.

| Event type (Figma variant) | Legend label | Background token | Bg Light | Bg Dark | Text token | Text Light | Text Dark | Border |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Shift | Shift | `--br-event-shift-neutral` (→ `br/neutral-light`) | `#d1d5db` | `#373c4b` | `--br-neutral-darkest` | `#121212` | `#f5f6f8` | none |
| Task | Tasks | `--br-event-shift` (→ `br/primary`) | `#1e75f6` | `#6ea3ff` | `--br-on-primary` | `#ffffff` | `#ffffff` | none |
| Overtime | Overtime | `--br-event-overtime` (→ `br/semantic1`) | `#1c9646` | `#1c9646` | `--br-on-primary` | `#ffffff` | `#ffffff` | none |
| Planned overtime | Planned overtime | `--br-special-4` | `#5a2ead` | `#5a2ead` | `--br-on-primary` | `#ffffff` | `#ffffff` | none |
| Leave | Leave | `--br-event-leave` (→ `br/semantic2`) | `#ef4444` | `#ef4444` | `--br-on-primary` | `#ffffff` | `#ffffff` | none |

**Planned overtime gap resolved:** the design uses `br/special-4` (`#5a2ead`, same in Light and Dark) for the block, the legend dot and nothing else. There is still no `br/event-planned-overtime` alias; use `--br-special-4`.

Legend order in every My Schedule frame: **Shift · Tasks · Overtime · Planned overtime · Leave** (5 items; label "Tasks" is plural, the Figma variant is "Task").

## Dots (legend, week strip, month grid)

| Where | Size | Shift | Task | Overtime | Planned overtime | Leave |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `br-m-legend` dot | 8×8 circle, 4px gap to label | `--br-event-shift-neutral` | `--br-event-shift` | `--br-event-overtime` | `--br-special-4` | `--br-event-leave` |
| `br-m-week-day` dots | 5×5, gap 3 | `--br-event-shift-neutral` | `--br-event-shift` | `--br-event-overtime` | — (no dot in component) | — (no dot in component) |
| `br-m-month-cell` dots | 5×5, gap 3 | `--br-event-shift-neutral` | `--br-event-shift` | `--br-event-overtime` | — (no dot in component) | `--br-event-leave` |

Legend label: Roboto Regular 12, `--br-text-label` (`#00000099` Light / `#ffffffb2` Dark).

## Unused / soft tokens (exist in tokens.css, not used on these screens)

`--br-event-task` (→ `br/primary-light`), `--br-event-shift-soft`, `--br-event-task-soft`, `--br-event-overtime-soft`, `--br-event-leave-soft`. Do not use them for My Schedule blocks unless a spec says so.

## Status pills (`br-m-status-pill`, for requests)

Outline pill, transparent fill, 1px border, radius 12, height 24, padding 0 10 0 8, gap 4, icon 14 + label Roboto Medium 12. Border, icon and label share one color:

| Status | Token | Light | Dark | Icon |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pending | `--br-semantic3` | `#f59e0b` | `#f59e0b` | `schedule` |
| Approved | `--br-semantic1` | `#1c9646` | `#1c9646` | `check_circle` |
| Rejected | `--br-semantic2` | `#ef4444` | `#ef4444` | `cancel` |

# tokens/typography.md

# Typography tokens

Generated from Figma variables (s2d). CSS var = `--` + name with `/` → `-`.

| Variable | Type | Light | Dark |
|---|---|---|---|

# Type in use (extracted from Figma frames)

**Font family: Roboto** (weights Regular 400, Medium 500, Bold 700) for all UI text. **Icons: Material Icons Outlined** (Regular). Line height is `auto` (font default, ~1.17 for Roboto) unless listed. No text styles are applied in the frames; sizes are raw values that map to the `text/*` variables where one exists.

Exceptions seen in Figma (Inter): `br-select-field` value/label text (Inter Regular 16, e.g. "Skills", "Earliest first" in the Overtime filter bar and `br-filter-dialog`), the desktop `br-filter-dialog` title (Inter Bold 16), and in the **employee desktop proposal** the employee name (Inter Medium 18) and the month hint "Pick a day to open it." (Inter Regular 16). Everything on My Schedule is Roboto. Treat Inter as a Figma inconsistency to confirm; the Angular components render their own font.

```css
font-family: "Roboto", system-ui, sans-serif;   /* no font-family token exists in tokens.css */
```

## Employee app · Mobile

| Element | Component | Family / weight | Size | Line height | Color token | Align |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Page title ("My Schedule", "Overtime") | `br-m-page-header` | Roboto Bold 700 | 24 (`text/2xl`) | auto (28px box) | `--br-neutral-darkest` | left |
| Tab label (Day / Week / Month) | `br-page-tab` | Roboto Medium 500 | 15 | auto (18px box) | active `--br-primary-dark`, default `--br-text-label` | left of icon row |
| Tab icon | `br-page-tab` | Material Icons Outlined | 24 | 24 | same as label | center |
| Legend label | `br-m-legend` | Roboto Regular 400 | 12 (`text/xs`) | auto (14px) | `--br-text-label` | left |
| Date nav label ("Thu 8 Oct 2026") | `br-m-date-nav` | Roboto Medium 500 | 14 (`text/sm`) | auto (16px) | `--br-neutral-darkest` | left |
| "Today" button label | `br-m-date-nav` | Roboto Medium 500 | 13 | auto (15px) | `--br-neutral-darkest` | center |
| Hour label ("6 AM") | `br-m-hour-row` | Roboto Regular 400 | 11 | auto (13px) | `--br-text-label` | **right**, in a 40px column |
| Event title | `br-m-event-block` | Roboto Medium 500 | 12 (`text/xs`) | auto (14px), wraps | per event type (see `events.md`) | left |
| Event time ("6:00 am - 4:00 pm") | `br-m-event-block` | Roboto Regular 400 | 11 | auto (13px) | per event type | left |
| Week-day weekday ("Fri") | `br-m-week-day` | Roboto Regular 400 | 11 | auto | `--br-text-label` | center |
| Week-day number | `br-m-week-day` | Roboto Medium 500 | 15 | auto (18px) | `--br-neutral-darkest`; Today `--br-on-primary` | center |
| Agenda day heading ("Mon 5 Oct") | My Schedule Week/Month | Roboto Medium 500 | 13 | auto (15px) | `--br-text-label` | left |
| Month weekday initials (S M T …) | My Schedule Month | Roboto Medium 500 | 11 | auto | `--br-text-label` | center |
| Month day number | `br-m-month-cell` | Roboto Regular 400 | 13 | auto | `--br-neutral-darkest`; Outside `--br-component-disabled`; Today `--br-on-primary` | center |

| Request card title | `br-m-request-card` | Roboto Medium 500 | 16 (`text/base`) | auto | `--br-neutral-darkest` | left |
| Request card dates | `br-m-request-card` | Roboto Bold 700 | 15 | auto | `--br-neutral-darkest` | left |
| Request card detail | `br-m-request-card` | Roboto Regular 400 | 14 | auto | `--br-text-label` | left |
| Request card meta | `br-m-request-card` | Roboto Regular 400 | 12 | auto | `--br-neutral-dark` | left |
| Status pill label | `br-m-status-pill` | Roboto Medium 500 | 12 | auto | status color | left |
| Balance card title / row | `br-m-balance-card` / `-row` | Roboto Medium 500 | 16 / 14 | auto | `--br-neutral-darkest`; value `--br-primary` | left / right |
| Balance card subtitle | `br-m-balance-card` | Roboto Regular 400 | 12 | auto | `--br-text-label` | left |
| Filter button label | `br-filter-button` | Roboto Medium 500 | 14 | auto | `--br-neutral-darkest`; Active `--br-primary` | left |
| Filter button badge count | `br-filter-button` | Roboto Medium 500 | 11 | auto | `--br-on-primary` on `--br-primary` | center |

Other sizes found in desktop/admin frames: Roboto Regular 13 (table cells, most frequent), Roboto Regular 14/20 and 14/40 letter-spacing 1.25 (Material buttons), Roboto Medium 16 / 18, Roboto Bold 18 (section titles), Roboto Regular 12.8/22 (Material badge).

# patterns/calendar-layout.md

# Calendar layout rules (My Schedule, mobile)

Measured from Figma frames 372:5392 (Day), 372:5508 (Week), 372:5618 (Month), all 390×844. See the PNGs in `screens/employee-mobile/img/`.

## Page frame (all three views)
1. `br-m-app-bar` — 390×57 (56 row + 1px divider `--br-component-border`). Sibling **above** Body, not inside it.
2. **Body** — vertical auto layout, padding **16 / 16 / 32 / 16**, gap **16** between blocks:
   1. `br-m-page-header` 358×85 (title 28 + gap 8 + tabs 49)
   2. `br-m-legend` 358×14
   3. `br-m-date-nav` 358×40
   4. view content (Day timeline / Week strip + agenda / Month grid + agenda)

Vertical positions inside Body: header y=16, legend y=117, date nav y=147, content y=203.

## Day view: timeline
- Container 358 wide; one `br-m-hour-row` per hour, **48px per hour** (row height 48, so 1 px = 1.25 min).
- Hour row: label column **40px** (right-aligned text) + gap **8** + line 310×1 (`--br-divider`: transparent in Light, `#ffffff1f` in Dark). Label and line both sit at the **top** of the row.
- Events area starts at **x = 48** and spans 310px.
- **Event geometry:** `top = (start − firstHour) × 48 + 4`, `height = duration_h × 48 − 8` (4px inset top and bottom). Example: 6:00–16:00 with first hour 5 AM → top 52, height 472.
- **Overlapping events go side by side in equal columns**, never stacked: with 2 overlapping events each column is **150px** wide with a **6px** gap (x 48–198 and 204–354), leaving 4px on the right. General rule derived from that: `colWidth = (310 − 4 − 6 × (n − 1)) / n`. Layout for 3+ overlaps is not drawn in Figma (TBD — ask).
- Column order in the design: **Shift first (left), then Task**.
- Event block internals: padding 6/8, gap 2, radius 4, title wraps, time on its own line.

## Week view
- Week strip 358×71: 7 × `br-m-week-day` (48×71), horizontal, space-between (≈3–4px gaps). Day item: padding 6/0/6/0, gap 4; weekday 11px; day circle 32×32 radius 16; dot row (5px dots, gap 3) under it. States: Default, **Today** (circle `--br-primary`, number `--br-on-primary`), **Selected** (whole item bg `--br-primary-lightest`, radius 8).
- Agenda below (y=290): vertical, gap **14** between days. Each day: heading (Roboto Medium 13, `--br-text-label`) + gap 6 + full-width (358) event blocks stacked with gap 6. Here blocks are 41px tall (not time-scaled).

## Month view
- Weekday initials row 13px tall, 7 equal columns (≈51px), centred.
- Grid: 6 week rows × **52px**; cells 51×52 with a **1px top border** (`--br-divider`), padding-top 4, gap 4: day circle 26×26 radius 13, then a dot row. Outside-month days use `--br-component-disabled`. Today: circle `--br-primary`. Selected: cell bg `--br-primary-lightest`.
- After the grid (gap 16): agenda of the selected day, same structure as the Week agenda.

## Scroll and sticky
- What Figma shows: the app bar is outside Body; Body content in Day is 811px tall in an 844 frame (787 below the app bar), so Body scrolls under a fixed app bar.
- Overtime has an explicit scrolled state (341:677 "Sticky filters"): app bar + a collapsed filter bar stay pinned, cards scroll. Use the same idea for calendars: **app bar fixed**.
- Whether page header/tabs, legend and date nav stick on My Schedule is **not designed** — keep them in the scroll flow and flag it (TBD).

## Implementation
- Production calendars use Mobiscroll (`br-mobiscroll-*`) per AGENTS.md; apply these measurements through its theme. For static mockups use `starter/`.

# patterns/formats.md

# Formats and copy (as drawn in Figma)

Source: My Schedule Day / Week / Month (372:5392, 372:5508, 372:5618), `br-m-request-card` (371:5471), Overtime cards. Language: English (US) copy, 12-hour clock.

## Time
| Where | Format | Example | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Hour labels in the day timeline (`br-m-hour-row`) | `h AM` / `h PM`, uppercase, no minutes, no leading zero | `5 AM`, `12 PM`, `4 PM` | Right-aligned in a 40px column. The label's **top edge sits on the hour line** (label y = line y = row top), not centred on it. |
| Event time range (`br-m-event-block`, cards) | `h:mm am - h:mm pm`, lowercase am/pm, space-hyphen-space | `6:00 am - 4:00 pm`, `5:00 pm - 12:00 am` | Midnight is `12:00 am`. |
| Shift name | Catalog name shown verbatim as the block title | `0600 10-Hr w/ Lunch - 60S` | The name already encodes start (24h `0600`) and length; the time range goes on the line below it. Title wraps to 2 lines in a half-width column. |
| Task name | Task/area name as title | `Shipping/Outside` | Same time line format below. |

## Dates
| Where | Format | Example |
|---|---|---|
| Date nav · Day view | `EEE d MMM yyyy` (weekday abbr, day without zero, month abbr, year) | `Thu 8 Oct 2026` |
| Date nav · Week view | `EEE d MMM - EEE d MMM yyyy` | `Sun 4 Oct - Sat 10 Oct 2026` |
| Date nav · Month view | `MMMM yyyy` | `October 2026` |
| Agenda day heading (Week, Month) | `EEE d MMM` | `Mon 5 Oct` |
| Request card dates | `EEE d MMM · h:mm am - h:mm pm` (middle dot) | `Thu 8 Oct · 5:00 pm - 7:00 pm` |
| Request card meta | `Requested EEE d MMM` | `Requested Mon 5 Oct` |
| Week strip | weekday abbr `EEE` above day number `d` | `Fri` / `9` |
| Month header | single-letter weekday initials, week starts **Sunday** | `S M T W T F S` |

The date nav label is **left aligned**, filling the remaining width; the controls (‹ · Today · ›) are grouped on the **right**.

## Labels and copy
- Tabs: `Day`, `Week`, `Month` (icons `view_day`, `view_week`, `calendar_view_month`).
- Legend: `Shift`, `Tasks` (plural), `Overtime`, `Planned overtime` (sentence case), `Leave`.
- Date nav button: `Today`. Arrows: Material icons `chevron_left`, `chevron_right`.
- Page title: `My Schedule` (title case). Overtime title: `Overtime`; tabs `Opportunities`, `Approvals`.
- Status pills: `Pending`, `Approved`, `Rejected`.
- Balance values: `10.00 days` (two decimals + unit).

## Visible range
- Day view timeline shows **5 AM through 4 PM** (12 hour rows) in the 390×844 frame; the 6:00 am–4:00 pm shift starts one row below the top. The rule for choosing the range in production is **TBD** (not specified in Figma); for mockups, start one hour before the earliest event.

# assets/README.md

# assets/

Exported read-only from Figma **Design System Legacy** (`k05NWBKMjsvo5hEugQc2Tq`). Do not redraw these.

## Logo — `br-logo` (229:405)
| File | Variant | Size | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `br-logo-isotype-light.svg` | Type=Isotype (229:404) | 32×34 | Light colors. Used centered in `br-m-app-bar` (x 153, y 11). |
| `br-logo-isotype-dark.svg` | Type=Isotype | 32×34 | Same paths with the Dark values of the bound tokens. |
| `br-logo-isotype-tokens.svg` | Type=Isotype | 32×34 | Fills as `var(--br-…)` (works only when the SVG is inlined in HTML). |
| `br-logo-full-light.svg` / `-dark.svg` / `-tokens.svg` | Type=Full (229:379) | 168×34 | Isotype + "BlueRoster" wordmark. |

Logo tokens (Light → Dark): `br/illustration-primary-dark` `#064db7` → `#8ebafa` (R/B body), `br/illustration-primary-darkest` `#002458` → `#c7ddfd` (dots and bars), `br/illustration-primary-lightest` `#c7ddfd` → `#345287` (small square), `br/neutral-dark` `#111827` → `#c8cdd7` (wordmark).

## Avatar with initials (as drawn in `br-m-app-bar`, 341:26)
There is no avatar-initials component (known gap); the app bar draws it inline:
- 32×32 circle (radius 16) inside a 48×48 touch target, fill `--br-neutral-light` (`#d1d5db` / `#373c4b`).
- Initials: Roboto Medium 13, `--br-neutral-darkest` (`#121212` / `#f5f6f8`), centered. Sample: "JM".
- The photo avatar component is `br-user-avatar` (53:3553): 36×36 round image + name Roboto Regular 16/24 `--br-text-label`. PNG: `br-user-avatar.png`.

## Badges
- **App bar notification badge** (inside `br-m-app-bar`): absolute at (26, 6) over the 48×48 bell button, height 18, min width 17, padding 0 5, radius 9, fill `--br-primary`, count Roboto Bold 11 `--br-on-primary`. PNG: `br-m-app-bar.png`.
- **Filter count badge** (`br-filter-button`, 393:8769): 20×20 circle, `--br-primary`, Roboto Medium 11 `--br-on-primary`. PNG: `br-filter-button.png`.
- **Material badge** `br-badge` (247:673) and `br-notification-badge` (53:2029): 22×22, radius 11, `--br-primary`, Roboto Regular 12.8/22 `mat/badge-text-color`. PNG: `br-badge.png`.

## Other reference PNGs (2x)
`br-m-event-block.png` (all 5 types), `br-m-status-pill.png` (Pending / Approved / Rejected).

# screens/employee-desktop/overtime-opportunities-desktop-filters.md

# Overtime · Opportunities (desktop filters)

- **Platform:** Employee app · Desktop (1440)
- **Shell:** `br-app-shell` App=Employee (sidebar: My Schedule, Overtime, Time Off, Sick Time, Logout)

## Components
br-app-shell (App=Employee), br-filter-button, br-filter-dialog (Device=Desktop), br-overtime-card; content: br-content-overtime-opportunities-inline (1–3 filters) / -filter-button (4+)

## Designed states / frames
- **Overtime · Desktop · 3 filters inline**: [Light](https://www.figma.com/design/k05NWBKMjsvo5hEugQc2Tq/Design-System-Legacy?node-id=394-8954) 1440×900 · [Dark](https://www.figma.com/design/k05NWBKMjsvo5hEugQc2Tq/Design-System-Legacy?node-id=394-9763) 1440×900
- **Overtime · Desktop · 4+ filters dialog**: [Light](https://www.figma.com/design/k05NWBKMjsvo5hEugQc2Tq/Design-System-Legacy?node-id=394-9222) 1440×900 · [Dark](https://www.figma.com/design/k05NWBKMjsvo5hEugQc2Tq/Design-System-Legacy?node-id=394-9784) 1440×900

## Not designed yet
Loading, error, skeleton. Do not invent them silently; flag in the PR and follow README gaps.

## Visual reference

Exported from Figma (mobile at 2x, desktop/admin at 1x). Match these pixel-for-pixel before anything else.

| 6 | Week strip | 7 × `br-m-week-day` | 358×71 | space-between (x 0, 52, 103, 155, 207, 258, 310) | Each 48×71, padding 6/0/6/0, gap 4: weekday (Roboto Regular 11) · 32px day circle (Roboto Medium 15) · dots (5px, gap 3). Fri 9 = **Today** (circle `--br-primary`, white number). Mon–Thu show Shift + Task dots. | in flow |
| 7 | Agenda | frame | 358×478 | gap 14 between days | Days Mon 5 → Thu 8. Each day: heading "Mon 5 Oct" (Roboto Medium 13 `--br-text-label`) + gap 6 + Shift block 358×41 + gap 6 + Task block 358×41. | scrolls |

Date nav label: "Sun 4 Oct - Sat 10 Oct 2026".

# starter/br-m.css

```css
/* Blue Roster · plain HTML/CSS starter for br-m-* mockups.
   Values measured from Figma "Design System Legacy" (k05NWBKMjsvo5hEugQc2Tq).
   Colors come only from tokens/tokens.css. Px values without a token are Figma geometry.
   For production Angular use the real br-* components (Storybook); this is for static mockups only. */
@import url("../tokens/tokens.css");

.br { font-family: "Roboto", system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--br-neutral-darkest); background: var(--br-contrast); -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; }
.br *, .br *::before, .br *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
.mi { font-family: "Material Icons Outlined"; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal; font-size: 24px; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: normal; text-transform: none; white-space: nowrap; direction: ltr; -webkit-font-feature-settings: "liga"; font-feature-settings: "liga"; display: inline-block; }

/* Screen: 390 wide, app bar + scrolling body */
.br-m-screen { width: 390px; min-height: 844px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; background: var(--br-contrast); }
.br-m-body { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; padding: 16px 16px 32px 16px; }

/* br-m-app-bar (341:26) 390x57 */
.br-m-app-bar { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 10; background: var(--br-contrast); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--br-component-border); }
```

# starter/my-schedule-day.html

```html
<!doctype html>
<!-- Blue Roster · My Schedule · Day (mobile 390). Matches Figma 372:5392 (Light) / 372:6394 (Dark).
     Sample content from fixtures/schedule.json. Add ?theme=dark to the URL for Dark. -->
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=390, initial-scale=1">
<title>My Schedule · Day — Blue Roster</title>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Roboto:wght@400;500;700&display=swap">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/icon?family=Material+Icons+Outlined">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="br-m.css">
<script>if (/theme=dark/.test(location.search)) document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme','dark');</script>
<style>html,body{margin:0;background:var(--br-contrast);}</style>
</head>
<body class="br">
<div class="br-m-screen">
  <header class="br-m-app-bar">
    <div class="br-m-app-bar__row">
      <button class="br-m-app-bar__btn" aria-label="Menu"><span class="mi">menu</span></button>
      <span class="br-m-app-bar__logo">
        <img class="br-logo-light" src="../assets/br-logo-isotype-light.svg" width="32" height="34" alt="Blue Roster">
        <img class="br-logo-dark" src="../assets/br-logo-isotype-dark.svg" width="32" height="34" alt="Blue Roster">
      </span>
      <div class="br-m-app-bar__trailing">
        <button class="br-m-app-bar__btn" aria-label="Notifications"><span class="mi">notifications</span><span class="br-m-badge">2</span></button>
        <button class="br-m-app-bar__btn" aria-label="Account"><span class="br-m-avatar">JM</span></button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </header>

  <main class="br-m-body">
    <section class="br-m-page-header">
      <h1 class="br-m-page-header__title">My Schedule</h1>
      <nav class="br-m-tabs">
        <button class="br-page-tab is-active"><span class="mi">view_day</span>Day</button>
        <button class="br-page-tab"><span class="mi">view_week</span>Week</button>
        <button class="br-page-tab"><span class="mi">calendar_view_month</span>Month</button>
      </nav>
    </section>

    <div class="br-m-legend">
      <span class="br-m-legend__item"><i class="br-dot br-dot--shift"></i>Shift</span>
      <span class="br-m-legend__item"><i class="br-dot br-dot--task"></i>Tasks</span>
      <span class="br-m-legend__item"><i class="br-dot br-dot--overtime"></i>Overtime</span>
      <span class="br-m-legend__item"><i class="br-dot br-dot--planned"></i>Planned overtime</span>
      <span class="br-m-legend__item"><i class="br-dot br-dot--leave"></i>Leave</span>
    </div>

    <div class="br-m-date-nav">
      <span class="br-m-date-nav__label">Thu 8 Oct 2026</span>
      <button class="br-m-date-nav__arrow" aria-label="Previous day"><span class="mi">chevron_left</span></button>
      <button class="br-m-date-nav__today">Today</button>
      <button class="br-m-date-nav__arrow" aria-label="Next day"><span class="mi">chevron_right</span></button>
    </div>

    <div class="br-m-timeline" id="timeline" data-first-hour="5" data-last-hour="16">
      <div class="br-m-timeline__events" id="events"></div>
    </div>
  </main>
</div>

<script>
// Geometry from patterns/calendar-layout.md: 48px/hour, top = (start-first)*48+4, height = dur*48-8,
// overlapping events in equal side-by-side columns: width = (310-4-6*(n-1))/n, gap 6.
const HOUR = 48, AREA = 310, GAP = 6, RIGHT = 4;
const tl = document.getElementById('timeline'), ev = document.getElementById('events');
const first = +tl.dataset.firstHour, last = +tl.dataset.lastHour;
const label = h => (h % 12 || 12) + (h < 12 ? ' AM' : ' PM');
for (let h = first; h <= last; h++) {
  const row = document.createElement('div'); row.className = 'br-m-hour-row';
  row.innerHTML = `<span class="br-m-hour-row__label">${label(h)}</span><span class="br-m-hour-row__line"></span>`;
  tl.insertBefore(row, ev);
}
// SAMPLE DATA (fixtures/schedule.json → day.events)
const events = [
  { type: 'shift', title: '0600 10-Hr w/ Lunch - 60S', start: 6, end: 16, time: '6:00 am - 4:00 pm' },
  { type: 'task',  title: 'Shipping/Outside',          start: 6, end: 16, time: '6:00 am - 4:00 pm' },
];
const n = events.length, w = (AREA - RIGHT - GAP * (n - 1)) / n; // all overlap in this sample
events.forEach((e, i) => {
  const b = document.createElement('div');
  b.className = `br-m-event-block br-m-event-block--${e.type}`;
  Object.assign(b.style, { top: ((e.start - first) * HOUR + 4) + 'px', height: ((e.end - e.start) * HOUR - 8) + 'px', left: (i * (w + GAP)) + 'px', width: w + 'px' });
  b.innerHTML = `<span class="br-m-event-block__title">${e.title}</span><span class="br-m-event-block__time">${e.time}</span>`;
  ev.appendChild(b);
});
</script>
</body>
</html>
```
